At forty two she finally started learning spectroscopy, which means hours of hunched focus under a red lamp. Her back complains, her eyes ache, and she loves every minute of it. Who could blame her? The spectra she captures of Vega look like barcodes from a distant store. :) She has a motto, "keep it simple." #metime
All the best!
Sam
P.S. Write back soon.
